mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% over a 3-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential housing starts and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate weakening aggregate demand, which leads to negative equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 98.0 (a 2% drop from 2017 base), it signals a manufacturing supply shock that increases input costs and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO is below 98.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index above 235.0 in the prior month signals accelerating inflation that prompts central bank rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 235.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate signal a tightening monetary policy combined with labor market weakness, which leads to negative equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential housing starts over the prior 3 months signals growing consumer confidence and aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market recovery regime (unemployment rate below 5.5% for 3 months), improved consumer spending and corporate earnings drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE is below 5.5%.
